title: Imaging Network for Childhood Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Using Data with Extended Diagnostics
summary: Acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (ALL) is the most common form of childhood leukaemia. Thanks to continuously improved treatment strategies, the survival rates of children and adolescents with ALL are rising steadily and are now over 90%. As a result of this positive development, problems/complications  are increasingly coming to the fore, that can be caused by the disease itself or by the therapy. These complications can have a major impact on children’s health and can increase the risk of illness and mortality. In children with ALL, therapy-associated and disease-related adverse events include pulmonary complications, such as pneumonia caused by fungal infections, or effects on bone health like reduction of bone mineral density. Although the ALL-BFM (Berlin-Frankfurt-Münster) study group in Germany collects relevant clinical data, including treatment regimens and outcomes, in a structured manner, image data, especially Computer tomography (CT) data, of children and adolescents with ALL have not yet been systematically collected and analysed at a national level. As collaboration between RACOON and ALL-BFM study group, (pediatric) radiology and pediatric oncology departments of up to 33 German university hospitals are participating in this retrospective project. RACOON-INCLUDED aims to use evaluation methods based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) to improve the early diagnosis and characterisation of invasive fungal infections, the prediction of disease progression and therapy success based on various data sources, and the detection and quantification of therapy-associated changes in bone health in paediatric ALL patients.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of children and adolescents with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) who have been collected in the ALL-BFM study group since 2000 and have available chest CT examinations from participating sites of the ALL-BFM study group and the RACOON infrastructure

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Enrollment in studies of ALL-BFM study group since 2000
- Confirmed diagnosis of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) with documented adverse events
-  available chest CT examination suitable for retrospective analysis and radiological evaluation.
Exclusion criteria:
- ALL patients without documented adverse events
- Absence of available CT imaging examinations
